content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing an issue with an analog bar not retaining its value after a power cycle; the value resets to 0. The animation settings specify a minimum of 15 and a maximum of 24. The block type is VW. When I adjust the bar, it only accepts values between 15 and 24, but after restarting the [product_name] and without interacting with the bar, it defaults to 0. Does anyone have suggestions?
How are you reading the value (VW1) in the [product_name]? Are you doing this through the analog network input?
That’s problematic. Would you be able to upload your diagram and associated project files as a ZIP archive? This way, I can review the setup in detail.

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue is that the analog bar does not preserve its configured value after a power cycle, reverting to 0 and failing to maintain the desired persistence. The lack of value retention creates confusion and interrupts workflow. While one user has initiated troubleshooting by requesting relevant files, no resolution has been reached yet.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the analog bar setting to be retained across power cycles or stop modes, so the value does not have to be reset manually each time.
